Read in pQTM dataset
```{r cars}

pQTM <- read_excel("R:/ARIC/Users/yl13544/02_EWAS_Tryptophan/01 Result/CpG_kt_ratio_pQTM.xlsx")
colnames(pQTM)

# Count unique proteins
n_proteins <- length(unique(pQTM$protein))
print(unique(pQTM$CpG)) # there are 28 CpG in total, 2 CpGs do not indicate any association (either cis or trans) with protein

# Count unique CpGs
n_cpgs <- length(unique(pQTM$CpG))

# Print the results
cat("Number of unique proteins:", n_proteins, "\n")
cat("Number of unique CpGs:", n_cpgs, "\n")


```


```{r pressure, echo=FALSE}

# Get count of unique proteins associated with each CpG
protein_count_per_cpg <- pQTM %>%
  group_by(CpG) %>%
  summarise(
    n_proteins = n_distinct(protein),
    proteins = paste(unique(protein), collapse = "; ")
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(n_proteins))

# View the result
print(protein_count_per_cpg) #worth noting that cg07839457 associates with 34 different protein, including TDO2

#save the results 
write_xlsx(protein_count_per_cpg, "R:/ARIC/Users/yl13544/02_EWAS_Tryptophan/01 Result/protein_count_per_cpg.xlsx")


```


```{r}
# Load necessary package
library(dplyr)

# Define your directory path
folder_path <- "R:/ARIC/Users/yl13544/02_EWAS_Tryptophan/01 Result/GWAS"

# Define your CpGs of interest
cpgs_to_keep <- c(
  "cg07839457", "cg11699125", "cg16411857", "cg21979287", "cg16936953",
  "cg18942579", "cg01059398", "cg16306654", "cg09801824", "cg23387863",
  "cg03425812", "cg12828896", "cg00490406", "cg10636246", "cg03753191",
  "cg23904266", "cg12054453", "cg09249800", "cg08818207", "cg07878065",
  "cg02068052", "cg03957124", "cg27537252", "cg01409343", "cg13575798",
  "cg24741430", "cg04176813", "cg26140475", "cg14496081", "cg07830828"
)

# List and read _manhattan.txt files
file_list <- list.files(path = folder_path, pattern = "_manhattan\\.txt$", full.names = TRUE)

# Create named list of data frames
all_results <- setNames(
  lapply(file_list, read.table, header = TRUE, sep = "\t", stringsAsFactors = FALSE),
  gsub("_manhattan\\.txt$", "", basename(file_list))
)

# Filter out CpGs that start with "inv" and keep only those in your list
all_results_filtered <- all_results[
  !grepl("^inv", names(all_results)) & names(all_results) %in% cpgs_to_keep
]

# Set genome-wide significance threshold
sig_threshold <- 5e-8

# Create summary table using SNPID column
snp_summary <- lapply(names(all_results_filtered), function(cpg_id) {
  df <- all_results_filtered[[cpg_id]]
  sig_df <- df[df$P < sig_threshold, ]
  
  snp_string <- if ("SNPID" %in% names(sig_df)) paste(unique(sig_df$SNPID), collapse = "; ") else NA

  data.frame(
    CpG = cpg_id,
    n_significant_SNPs = nrow(sig_df),
    SNPIDs = snp_string
  )
}) %>% bind_rows()

# View summary
print(snp_summary)
write_xlsx(snp_summary, "R:/ARIC/Users/yl13544/02_EWAS_Tryptophan/01 Result/snp_summary.xlsx")


```
